A '''re-entry capsule''' was a capsule used for protection from [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] re-entry. They were used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], re-entry capsules housing modules of [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|''Trident''-class assault ships]] were disguised as falling [[Starship/Legends|starship]] debris to infiltrate [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched the capsules during the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|space battle]] over Kamino, and they landed in the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] to be reassembled by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droid]] crew for an assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].
